cannot: It cannot be carried onto this invoice now: open Payments to place it on another invoice of the order, or credit what is wrong first.
carried: The deposit is carried onto invoice {invoice}.
confirmAmount: {amount} placed on this invoice; the deposit request stays paid, at 0.
confirmExplain: Each payment's part on the deposit request is taken back and placed on this invoice, with a note saying why. A carry made by mistake is taken back like any placement.
explain: A deposit paid without a deposit invoice (an EU business with a VIES proof) stays on its request until it is carried onto the order's invoice: until then the invoice looks unpaid for that amount.
failed: Couldn't read the deposits to carry ({why}).

held.cannot: It cannot be carried onto this invoice now.
held.noRecord: Carrying a deposit needs the right to record payments.
held.reading: Reading what the carry would do…

previewing: Reading what the carry would do…
title: Deposit to carry
